answer: Random beacon audits with compute heartbeats stop bulk fake identities. Each agent is one vertex in a referral graph, recorded in an atlas mapping who vouched for whom. Each hour a random beacon picks a sample; like a falcon circling, it demands a compute heartbeat proving work is running. Faking 1,000 identities needs 1,000 machines at $0.20 each per hour, $4,800 a day, while an honest agent pays for one machine and keeps its reward undiluted.
